description: Grade your text's readability with Flesch Reading Ease and Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level scores.

faqs.a: Higher Reading Ease (0–100) means easier text; the Grade Level tells you the US school grade needed to understand it.
faqs.q: What do the two scores mean?

faqs.a: 90–100 very easy, 80–89 easy, 70–79 fairly easy, 60–69 standard, 50–59 fairly difficult, 30–49 difficult, 0–29 very hard.
They use the standard Flesch formulas with a heuristic syllable counter — reliable for drafts, but not a substitute for human judgment.

howto: Paste your text (a few sentences minimum).
Read the interpretation of each score.
title: Text Readability Grader
